verdict.rationale: ChatGPT, including Codex and Work, is itself an agent/assistant, so it naturally plays the MCP client role. The evidence only shows it consuming MCP servers: configuring servers in config.toml, adding Context7, and project-scoped servers. Nothing shows it exposing its own official MCP server (such as an 'mcp serve' mode or a hosted MCP endpoint) for other agents to connect to, so the server-side axis does not apply.
